name: Cush
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The sons of Ham: Cush is Ethiopia; Mizraim is Egypt; Phut is Libya, to the left of Egypt; and Canaan is the land where Jerusalem sits.

note.label: Genesis 10: Shem, Ham, Japheth, and Nimrod

points: “And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.” Ham was the youngest son of Noah and one of the eight persons who lived through the flood. He became the progenitor of the dark races, but he is not the father of the Negroes: the Egyptians, Ethiopians, Libyans (not the modern ones you see today) and the Canaanites. The sons of Ham are the Hamites, the Nilotes. The Ishmaelites, the people of Ishmael, are the Arabs, a totally different race of people. The Arabs are not the ancient Egyptians nor Libyans, and the Caucasians are not the Jews, the children of Israel.

note.label: The Purpose of God's Wrath and Mercy

points: “And the sons of Ham; Cush”: that’s Ethiopia. “And Mizraim”: write that down, Mizraim is Egypt. “And Phut”: north Africa.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

points: “And the sons of Cush”: out of Cush’s line, these are the Ethiopic nations, dark-skinned Africans.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

points: Cush begat Nimrod: these are Hamites. He began to be a mighty one in the earth: a leader, an elite leader, and evil as hell also. He was a mighty hunter before the Lord: he hunted after men; a man of the field too also. When it says mighty hunter, it means he was very evil, an evil leader or ruler.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth, a mighty hunter before the Lord, meaning he was against the Lord. The beginning of his kingdom was Babel in the land of Shinar. So after the flood, the first empire was Kush: the Ethiopians, the Sudan. These were mighty men with understanding. You look at these Discovery Channel programs and they have white people as the first empire; no, the Bible says the children of Ham were the first ruling empire on the earth after the flood. Before the flood, Cain built the first city.
Cush begat Nimrod: this is what we wanted to get to.
I want you to remember that name Nimrod, who was the son of Cush, an Ethiopian.

note.label: The Truth Behind Christmas and New Years

points: The sons of Ham are named: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan, and the sons that came from them.
The line of Cush is traced through to Nimrod, and the sons of Mizraim and of Canaan are listed with the peoples that came from them.
